prompt: Make a 10-second title card presentation: a headline fades in at 1s, a subtitle slides up under it at 3s, both fade out at 8s. Play/pause buttons. The entry file is `main.eligian` in the current directory, with one timeline named `title`. Use these element ids: `#headline` (carries the class `in` from 1s to 8s, and is hidden outside that range), `#subtitle` (visible from 3s to 8s, hidden before and after), `#play` and `#pause` (the buttons). An element counts as hidden when it or an ancestor has the `hidden` attribute or computes `display: none`, `visibility: hidden` or `opacity: 0` from your CSS; otherwise it is visible.
